name: Harness² Lab
description: Bounded Harness² experiments using DSH models: candidate generation, isolated trials, comparisons and reflection. Installation starts no experiment or automatic adoption. Linux/WSL Python 3.12+ is required for experiments.
descriptionZh: 复用 DSH 模型的 Harness² 实验：候选生成、隔离试跑、对照与反思。安装不会自动实验或采用配置；执行器需 Linux / WSL Python。
